description: Read your notifications (order fills, mission results, combat and system messages), newest first. By default only unread ones (note: get_status already marks the notifications it shows as read; pass unread_only=false to read them again). Read-only unless mark_read=true, which marks the returned ones as read. Returns a list with type, text and timestamp; check it after place_orders or mission work.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

mark_read.description: Mark the returned notifications as read (default false)

name: get_notifications
